name: abacum
description: Ask about your FP&A data in Abacum: budget vs actuals, forecasts, scenarios, variance and model logic.

interface.longDescription: Ask ChatGPT about your business, and get answers straight from your Abacum data. Abacum, the AI-native business planning platform, gives ChatGPT governed access to your workspace: actuals, budgets, forecasts and scenarios across every dimension, the tables in your Spaces, the logic behind every model and the source data that feeds them. Review budget vs actuals, see the variance behind what moved, and compare forecasts and scenarios, all on the same numbers your team plans on. ChatGPT can only reach what your Abacum user can see, and nothing saves without your approval. Built for FP&A and finance teams and the business leaders they plan with. Requires an Abacum account, with access turned on by your admin.
defaultPrompt: How are we tracking against budget this quarter?
Why did gross margin move last month?
Compare our base and downside scenarios for next year

positive.prompt: How did we do against budget last quarter in our P&L? Show actuals, budget and the biggest variances.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the P&L model and the active Budget scenario, then returns actuals, budget, variance and variance % per P&L line for the last closed quarter, and calls out the lines with the largest variance.

positive.description: Summarize a report in a space
positive.prompt: Which reports do we have in Abacum? Summarize the main table in our board reporting space.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the spaces the user can see, opens the board reporting space, loads its main table and summarizes the key numbers by period.

positive.description: Explain how a metric is calculated
positive.prompt: How is EBITDA calculated in our P&L model, and which lines drive it?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the EBITDA formula from the P&L model and walks through the variables it depends on, such as revenue, cost of sales and operating expenses.

positive.prompt: Compare budget and forecast revenue by month for this year.
positive.expected_behavior: Loads revenue from the active Budget and Forecast scenarios and returns a month by month table with both values and the difference.

positive.prompt: Which systems feed our Abacum data, and when were they last synced?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each dataset with its source system, row count and last sync date.

negative.description: Generic finance template, not company data
negative.prompt: Build me a three-statement financial model template for a SaaS startup.

negative.description: Public market data about another company
negative.prompt: What are Microsoft's latest quarterly revenue and P/E ratio?
What's the difference between a budget and a rolling forecast?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release of Abacum in ChatGPT. Ask about your company's plans and actuals: budget vs actuals, budget vs forecast, what's in your reports, how each metric is calculated and where your data comes from. You only see what your Abacum permissions allow.
